content_sections.heading: Balrampur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The Balrampur Anganwadi last date to submit the online application is 23 September 2026 . The notification does not separately mention a distinct application start date; candidates should refer to upanganwadibharti.in for the live application window.

rows.date: Not specified separately in the notification

content_sections.heading: Balrampur Anganwadi Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notification lists 236 vacancies for Anganwadi Karyakatri and 259 vacancies for Anganwadi Sahayika , spread across 11 Child Development Project areas in Balrampur district. Category-wise reservation (Unreserved, OBC, SC, ST) is provided for each project. Anganwadi centre-wise vacancy details, including detailed reservation break-up, are available at the offices of the District Magistrate, Chief Development Officer, Sub-District Magistrate, Block Development Officer, District Programme Officer and Child Development Project Officer, and also on upanganwadibharti.in.

content_sections.heading: Balrampur Anganwadi Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only women candidates are eligible to apply for Anganwadi Karyakatri and Anganwadi Sahayika posts under this notification. Beyond the basic educational qualification and age limit, the notification lays out a specific order of residence-based and family-status-based preference for selection to the Karyakatri post, described below.

content_sections.heading: Balrampur Anganwadi Qualification
content_sections.text: The minimum educational qualification is Intermediate (12th) or an equivalent qualification . Candidates with a higher qualification, up to postgraduate level, are also eligible, and the merit list will be prepared on the basis of the highest qualification held by the candidate.

content_sections.heading: Balrampur Anganwadi Selection Process
content_sections.text: For direct recruitment to the Anganwadi Karyakatri post, the notification specifies the following order of preference, applied within the same Gram Sabha/Ward: Widow woman of a family living below the poverty line, resident of the same Gram Sabha/Ward. If a widow is not available, a legally divorced or deserted woman of a family living below the poverty line, resident of the same Gram Sabha/Ward. If no widow/divorced/deserted woman candidate is found from a family below the poverty line, other women of a family below the poverty line, resident of the same Gram Sabha/Ward. Widow woman of a family living above the poverty line, resident of the same Gram Sabha/Ward. If a widow is not available, a legally divorced or deserted woman of a family living above the poverty line, resident of the same Gram Sabha/Ward. If no widow/divorced/deserted woman candidate is found from a family above the poverty line, other women of a family above the poverty line, resident of the same Gram Sabha/Ward. The notification specifies this priority order for the Anganwadi Karyakatri post; it does not separately state whether the same order applies to the Anganwadi Sahayika post. Reservation for Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and Other Backward Class candidates will be followed as per applicable government orders, and candidates claiming reservation benefits must attach a certificate issued by the competent authority with their online application.

content_sections.heading: Balrampur Anganwadi Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee amount is not specified in this notification.

content_sections.heading: Balrampur Anganwadi Salary
content_sections.text: Anganwadi Karyakatri and Anganwadi Sahayika are appointed on an honorarium (mandeya) basis, as stated in the notification. The specific honorarium amount is not specified in this notice; candidates may refer to the referenced Government Order dated 17 September 2025 or the department website for honorarium details.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Balrampur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the departmental website, upanganwadibharti.in . Fill the online application form in the prescribed format available on the website. Applications are accepted only online - offline or postal applications/documents are not valid. Upload self-attested, clean and readable copies of all documents mentioned in the online form. Attach the relevant reservation certificate, if applicable, issued by the competent authority. For widow candidates, upload the death certificate issued by the Gram Panchayat Officer/concerned Nagar Nikay along with a certified copy of the family register. For divorced/deserted candidates, upload the legal order issued by the Hon'ble Court. Ensure income, residence and caste certificates are the online-verifiable versions issued by the competent authority/Tehsil with digital signature, as specified in the notification. Submit the application before the last date. Candidates should check that all facts, figures and educational marks entered are accurate - incorrect or fabricated entries will lead to cancellation of candidature.

content_sections.heading: Balrampur Anganwadi Apply Online
content_sections.text: The Balrampur Anganwadi apply online link is available on the official departmental website, upanganwadibharti.in , and the last date to apply is 23 September 2026 . No offline or postal applications will be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Other Important Conditions
content_sections.text: At one Anganwadi centre, two women from the same family will not be appointed to the Anganwadi Karyakatri and Anganwadi Sahayika posts together. For vacant posts in wards under Nagar Palika Parishad Balrampur Shahar and Nagar Palika Parishad Utraula, the residence certificate must mention the ward. Detailed, Anganwadi centre-wise vacancy information including reservation break-up is available at the offices of the District Magistrate, Chief Development Officer, Sub-District Magistrate, Block Development Officer, District Programme Officer, and Child Development Project Officer, as well as on upanganwadibharti.in.

faq.question: Q1. What is Balrampur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is the official notification issued by the District Programme Officer (Child Development), Balrampur, for direct recruitment to Anganwadi Karyakatri (Worker) and Anganwadi Sahayika (Helper) posts on an honorarium basis, across 11 Child Development Projects in Balrampur district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Balrampur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 236 vacancies for Anganwadi Karyakatri and 259 vacancies for Anganwadi Sahayika, making a combined total of 495 posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Balrampur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 23 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Balrampur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is Intermediate (12th) or equivalent. Candidates with a higher qualification up to postgraduate level are also eligible, and merit is prepared on the basis of the highest qualification held.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Balrampur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 35 years, as on the cut-off date of 01 July 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for Balrampur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply only online through upanganwadibharti.in by filling the prescribed application form and uploading self-attested copies of the required documents. Offline or postal applications are not accepted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Balrampur Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For the Anganwadi Karyakatri post, selection follows a defined preference order based on residence in the same Gram Sabha/Ward, family poverty-line status, and marital/widow status, along with merit based on educational qualification. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC candidates applies as per government orders.
